# Goal

Convert the raw local NCDB file into an analysis-ready local format.

## Recommended pipeline

```text
Raw NCDB file
    ↓
Read using supplied file structure
    ↓
Assign names and data types
    ↓
Validate row/column counts
    ↓
Audit missingness
    ↓
Save processed local copy
```

Parquet is convenient for repeated Python analyses because it preserves data types and loads quickly.

```python
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_parquet("data/processed/ncdb_master.parquet")
```

The exact parser should be adapted to the locally supplied NCDB file format and documentation.
